mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have fair conditions at Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 70 degrees. If you look to the skies tonight at 6:34 PM, you can catch the International Space Station rising in the west northwest over Cross Plains and traveling toward the northeast near Home Depot.

For city news, remember that Pellitteri Waste Systems manages our refuse and recycling. Please place your carts forward facing at the end of your driveway by 7 AM on your collection day, and use the Waste Wizard tool on the city website if you are unsure how to dispose of specific items. Also, the Military Ridge State Trail paving project is moving forward, with a public meeting scheduled for December 8 at the Senior Center.

It is a busy few days for our community. Yoga at Insight Wellness is on the calendar for today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's, plus live music back at Paddy Mac's.

Regarding the police report, on October 23, officers made contact with two 13-year-olds riding eMotos on Ashton Drive. Since they had been warned previously, their parents were cited for permitting the minors to operate the prohibited vehicles.
It is a great day to visit Culver's for the Chocolate Volcano flavor. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving up treats until 10 PM tonight.
